title: Spot the asteroid
blurb: One of these “stars” is the metal asteroid Psyche. Can you find it?
story: One of the dots in this picture is not a star. It is (16) Psyche, a metal-rich asteroid about 220 km across and the target of NASA's Psyche mission. Blink the two pictures, taken six and a half hours apart on 9 September 2025, and find the dot that moves. Then tick “Label known asteroids & comets” below to check your answer.

target.name: A star field in Taurus on 9 Sep 2025

source: NASA/IPAC IRSA SPHEREx Level-2 spectral images (collections spherex_dr1, spherex_qr3)
